title: web3supplychain
tagline: A tool to allow maintaining data for different stages of the 3D printing process
description: A tool to allow maintaining data for different stages of the 3D printing process. There are a variety of stages such as raw material extraction, chemical treatment, filament production and recycling. The whole thought process is to maintain transparency in the system. additionally we will be maintaining a console for the different stages to be maintained easily
how_its_made:
Used ethers-js to build the frontend and raw solidity for the backend. Additionally, will be maintaining metadata on IPFS.

For the downstream portal that will be built, we will be relying on indexers to index the events emitted by the smart contract. We are just beginners at smart contract architecture, so we think it would be best to store data in the form of time-series events.
